title: sentilab-open-publish/1
description: The participant's explicit, logged choice to publish a private entry (DESIGN rev 3 section 5.6): it names the proposal_sha256, comes from the same account, under accepted terms. Because it names the entry's private read handle, the command always travels sealed: a plaintext publish reply is private_requires_sealed and nothing in it is read. Terms (terms_not_accepted) and ownership (unknown_proposal) are checked after opening and before anything is made public; a refused publication changes nothing and is reported only privately.
